prompts.name: santa-sleigh
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single isolated Christmas winter coloring-book sticker. Santa sitting in a festive sleigh facing RIGHT, waving mitten, big simple beard and hat, rounded sleigh body with one broad decorative stripe and curled runners, one large sack behind Santa. No reindeer, no reins extending outside object. Wide side view. Friendly rounded storybook drawing, medium-simple detail, large closed regions easy for children to bucket fill. Confident black outlines roughly 12 pixels at 1024 source, target 5 pixels at final sticker size. ONLY black ink and solid opaque white interiors. Genuine transparent background outside object and through gaps. Entire object with margin. No gray, shading, gradients, hatching, texture, tiny details, text, ground shadows or extra objects.
